newsitem.title: UK: GEC in talks with Lockheed - paper.
newsitem.headline: GEC in talks with Lockheed - paper.

text.p: Britain's General Electric Co Plc is believed to be in talks about an alliance with U.S. military and aerospace giant Lockheed Martin, the Sunday Times said.

GEC officials were not immediately available for comment on the newspaper report which said that talks were taking place between Lockheed chairman Norman Augustine and GEC executives led by managing director George Simpson.

The paper said industry experts believe a deal would not involve cross-shareholding or full joint venture status but would probably be a two-way arrangement "providing each party with enhanced access to the other's market in specific areas of defence electronics".
